Owner decision 2026-10-01 (kb/Work PB1907, applied to STRING by kb/Work PB1908): document the behavior, follow GnuCOBOL 3.2 where it measurably differs, pin it. docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-STR1 to D-STR4: the statement runs in place - the image the earlier transfers built is stored into identifier-3 and a sender or an identifier delimiter that StorageOverlap.MayShareStorage cannot prove disjoint from identifier-3 is read when its transfer begins (libcob cob_string_append); the POINTER is read once at initiation and stored last (cob_string_init, cob_string_finish). A FUNCTION operand is an identifier of the statement and references a temporary data item (8.4.3.2.4 1) -> OK) that no transfer stores into, so GR10 never reaches it (kb/Work PB4973): every function of every sending, the first included, is identified and evaluated ONCE, up front, in statement order (14.6.4 7) -> OK; 14.9.49.4 11) selects the declarative by that order, kb/Work PB3261), FUNCTION RANDOM and a user-defined function included (D-STR4); only a data-item sender or identifier delimiter that StorageOverlap.MayShareStorage cannot prove disjoint from identifier-3 is read again at its transfer. The standard defines the function case (xyABCDEF); GnuCOBOL 3.2 diverges (xyXYCDEF). Golden pb1908_string_function_order pins the order (EC-BOUND-REF-MOD before EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT).
